rules-spawn.title: 🏠 Spawn Rules
rules-spawn.description: Rules regarding spawn area and spawn protection.

fields.name: 🚫 Spawn Destruction
fields.value: Any destruction of spawn (outside of pvp) is bannable by **up to 7 days**

fields.name: ⚠️ Pushing Players
fields.value: Pushing people out of spawn is **up to a 3 day ban** if the player is killed

rules-hacking.title: 🚨 Hacking & Cheating
rules-hacking.description: Rules regarding hacks, cheats, and unfair advantages

fields.name: ⚔️ Combat Cheats
fields.value: Combat cheats will always lead to a **3 day ban**

fields.name: 🖥️ Screenshare
fields.value: Denying a screenshare from a staff member is a **3 day ban**

fields.name: 🤖 Baritone
fields.value: Baritone is always a **3 day ban**

fields.name: 👁️ ESP/Extra Perception
fields.value: Any cheats which give you extra sensory perception is a **3 day ban**

fields.name: 🐛 Bug Reporting
fields.value: **Failure to report bugs & glitches is not allowed**

fields.name: 💤 AFK Cheats
fields.value: Any autoclickers or anything else which is not an official way to get AFK rewards, will result in a **1 day ban**

rules-chat.title: 💬 Chat Abuse Rules
rules-chat.description: Rules regarding chat behavior and language

fields.name: 🚫 Slurs
fields.value: Slurs are banned and are an **instant 1 day mute**

fields.name: 🚷 Inapropiate Chat
fields.value: Talking inapropiately will lead to a warn and then a 8h mute

fields.name: 🔞 Sexual Content
fields.value:
Sexual content is a **2 week mute then a 7day ban**
Sexual Abuse is an **instant ban** & if done against a minor you will be **forwarded for prosecution**

fields.name: 😤 Harassment
fields.value: Annoying or harassing anyone is **up to a 1 hour mute**

fields.name: 📢 Advertising
fields.value: Advertising or links of any kind is a **1 day mute**

fields.name: ⚠️ Harmful Suggestions
fields.value: Any suggestion of bodily harm or suicide to another person is a **14d mute then a 3d ban**

fields.name: ⚖️ Discrimination
fields.value: Any discrimination against a protected class is a **1d mute then a 3d mute**

fields.name: 🔒 Doxxing & DDoSing
fields.value: Doxxing & DDoSing is an **instant 1 week mute** depending on severity

fields.name: 📢 Spamming
fields.value: **Spamming & loud soundboards are disallowed**

rules-accounts.title: 👤 Account Abuse
rules-accounts.description: Rules regarding multiple accounts and abuse

fields.name: 🚫 Ban Evading
fields.value: Ban evading is an **instant IP ban on both accounts** and a **1 week extension** on your ban

fields.name: 🌊 Flooding
fields.value: Flooding the server leads to **all accounts being banned & IP banned**

fields.name: 📦 Storing Special Items
fields.value: **No storing special items on another account**

rules-teams.title: 👥 Team Rules
rules-teams.description: Rules regarding teams and team caps

fields.name: 👥 Team Cap
fields.value: Team cap is set at **5 people**

fields.name: 📋 Team Definition
fields.value:
A team is determined by:
• Sharing a base
• Not actively killing each other
• Free resource sharing
• Helping each other in fights

fields.name: ⚔️ Item Limits
fields.value: • Custom Items: **1 per person** (No team limit)

rules-duping.title: 🔧 Duping & Exploits
rules-duping.description: What exploits are allowed and disallowed

fields.name: ✅ Allowed Exploits
fields.value:
• String dupers & tripwire dupers
• TNT Duping

fields.name: ❌ Disallowed Exploits
fields.value:
• Any item dupe
• **Pearl glitching (NOT ALLOWED AT ALL)**
• Rail Duping

rules-contracts.title: 📜 IOU's, Contracts & Trades
rules-contracts.description: Rules regarding player agreements and trades

fields.name: 📝 Binding Contract Requirements
fields.value:
• A signed book from the person who did not write it OR a signed book per person (verbal confirmation works if clear)
• A clear base case (what happens if contract is not completed)
• A time period (like in 3 days)

fields.name: 💳 IOU Rules
fields.value:
• Maximum **3 IOU's** on one player at a time
• Can't make player break server rules or laws
• Don't carry over to next seasons
• Valid for **up to 14 days**
• Can't be used to make someone owe more IOU's
• Task must be completable in **under 1 day**

fields.name: 🚫 PVP Contracts
fields.value: **PVP contracts are NOT allowed**

fields.name: 💱 Trade Rules
fields.value:
• Use the trade room at spawn
• Interfering with a trade: **1 warn then 1d ban**
• Scamming: **1d ban & items get rerolled**
• Fraud: **1d ban & items get rerolled**

rules-pvp.title: ⚔️ PVP Rules
rules-pvp.description: Based on Diamond SMP rules - Important combat restrictions

fields.name: ❌ Banned Items/Actions in PVP
fields.value:
• **No Enderpearls in combat**
• No end crystals
• No respawn anchors
• No bed bombing
• No TNT minecarts in PVP
• No stasis chambers
• No elytra macing
• No storing special items/maces in or out of combat

fields.name: ✅ Allowed in PVP
fields.value: • **Chorus fruit is now permitted in combat**

fields.name: 🚫 Danger Logging
fields.value: **Danger logging is NOT allowed**

fields.name: ⚠️ Item Limits
fields.value: Bypassing item limits (**1 Custom Item per person**) is an **instant 1 day ban**

fields.name: 🔪 Naked Killing
fields.value:
**1 warn then 1d ban**
Things that count as naked killing:
• Stealing loot
• Snaking
• Hitting people
• Griefing builds
• Killing NPCs (dogs/villagers)

fields.name: 👥 Ganking Ratio: 3:1
fields.value:
**3v1 ✅** with mace/custom item ✅
**4v1 ❌** with mace/custom item ✅
**6v1 ❌** with mace/custom item ❌
**2v6 ✅** with mace/custom item ✅
**2v7 ❌** with mace/custom item ✅

fields.name: 🚪 Sealed PVP Areas
fields.value: Purposefully trying to escape from sealed PVP rooms is **1 warn then 1d ban**

footer.text: Punishments increase with repeated offenses • Staff words are final

rules-mods.title: 🔌 Allowed & Disallowed Mods
rules-mods.description: What mods you can and cannot use

fields.name: ✅ Allowed Mods
fields.value:
• Fullbright
• PVP Optimizers
• Litematica
• Mouse Tweaks
• Health Indicators
• Performance optimizers
• Replay Mod
• Minimap
• World Map
• Shulker Box Tooltips

fields.name: ❌ Disallowed Mods
fields.value:
• Freecam
• No Break Delay
• Xray
• Player Radar
• Entity ESP
• Autoclickers
• Macros & Scripts

rules-irl.title: 💰 IRL Trading & Transactions
rules-irl.description: Rules regarding real-money trading for in-game items or currency

fields.name: 🚫 Real-Money Trading (RMT)
fields.value: **IRL Trading (selling/buying in-game items, accounts, or services for real currency) is strictly disallowed.** This will result in an **instant ban**.

fields.name: ⚠️ Server Responsibility
fields.value: **The server will NOT be responsible for any losses, scams, or unfulfilled trades** that result from attempted IRL transactions. We will not refund any real-world money.

fields.name: ❌ Advertising RMT
fields.value: Advertising RMT or links to RMT sites will result in a **permanent ban**.

rules-teamfights.title: ⚔️ Team Fights
rules-teamfights.description: Rules specific to organized team fights

fields.name: 🤝 Temporary Teams
fields.value: Fighting with others in a team fight means you are considered to be in a **temporary team** for the duration of that fight

fields.name: 👥 Ganking Limits
fields.value: **No ganking limits apply** during team fights

fields.name: 🗡️ Special Items
fields.value:
• Custom Items: **1 per person**
• Maces: Maximum **2 per side**

fields.name: 📊 Team Fight Sizes
fields.value:
**Allowed:**
• 5v5
• 4v5
• 3v5

**Disallowed:**
• 6v4
• 8v6
